objective: Serve GET /api/v1/expression-states from the shared read-model surface so the default local deployment returns the committed expression contract with 200 instead of dying with an AttributeError and a dropped connection.
acceptance: a local server answers GET /api/v1/expression-states with 200 and the states/transitions contract, with no traceback and no dropped connection
the local and remote-capable controllers return the same expression contract, because the method now lives on the shared read model and the remote subclass inherits it
the route stays read-only and reads no event log, so it answers even when the run directory is empty and /readyz is 503
the expression enum and the allowed transitions are unchanged, so no new control state is exposed
OpenAPI keeps declaring 200 ExpressionContract and 503 Error, and the local 200 body matches the declared schema
a unit test exercises successful dispatch of the route, not only the shutdown rejection
evidence: local GET /api/v1/expression-states response: 200 application/json with states idle/thinking/uncertain/pleased and their sorted transitions
remote-capable controller response for the same route, byte-identical to the local body
server stderr empty across both requests: no AttributeError, no connection reset
targeted dashboard backend and shutdown test output
full suite compared against build/baseline.txt with no new failures
Task Packet and contract validation output
stop_conditions: the fix would expose a new control state or change the committed expression enum
a supported mode cannot list the static transitions without reading an event file
an interfaces schema or libs/contracts change is required
a modification outside allowed_paths is required
